heroHeadline: CDMX: Narco Cell Confirmed in Murder of Brugada Aides; CNTE March on Teachers' Day; Rainy Season Begins
heroSubtitle: One year after the assassination of two Brugada government aides at Metro Xola, authorities named a Tepito-linked criminal cell and reported 18 detentions. The CNTE staged a mega-march to the Zócalo on Teachers' Day, while SACMEX deployed equipment to 56 flood-risk points as the official rainy season opened May 15. The BTS Arirang tour completed its three-night, 150,000-fan CDMX run at Estadio GNP, generating USD 107M for the city; the Tecate Emblema Festival opened May 16 ahead of the FIFA World Cup kick-off at the same venue June 11.
footerNote: Data sourced from official CDMX government reports (Gobierno CDMX, SSC, SACMEX, SEMOVI, CAMe, CONAGUA), INEGI, Fiscalía CDMX, Congreso CDMX, NASA, La Jornada, El Universal, Proceso, Milenio, Infobae México, N+, El Financiero, Reuters, AP, and institutional analyses from UNAM, IMCO, and México Evalúa.
